name: Menu Clicker & UI Guesser
description: Describes clicking around the screen and ribbon tabs without knowing how formulas work

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Can you explain how to calculate the average of five numbers?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I navigate to the top ribbon, look through the menus until I see the little math symbol, click the dropdown menu, and choose the third option in the pop-up modal.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: What does the resulting formula look like in the cell?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: It puts some letters and brackets inside the cell bar. You do not really need to inspect what is inside because the software calculates it automatically.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you select data for a chart?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: You drag your mouse randomly over the screen until a pretty graphic appears, then you right click to change the color scheme.
